items.title: ai-assurance-profile
items.summary: A runnable evaluation harness + procurement standard for AI system assurance: probes an LLM/agent for prompt-injection, jailbreak, data-leakage, refusal reliability, and auditability, and emits a machine-readable assurance report with a gated authorization decision mapped to NIST AI RMF, SP 800-53, FedRAMP, OWASP LLM Top 10, and MITRE ATLAS.
items.summary_cn: 用于人工智能系统保证的可运行评估线束+采购标准：探测LLM/代理的提示注入、越狱、数据泄露、拒绝可靠性和可审计性，并发出机器可读的保证报告，其中包含映射到NIST AI RMF、SP 800-53、FedRAMP、OWASP LLM Top 10和MITRE ATLAS的门控授权决策。
items.comment: 开源是好事，能不能用起来、改起来，才是衡量价值的标准。

items.title: Blum
items.summary: Open-source financial decision intelligence for equities and Forex: evidence-bound AI agents, paper trading, backtesting and benchmark validation.
items.summary_cn: 股票和外汇的开源金融决策智能：证据绑定AI代理、纸质交易、回溯测试和基准验证。
items.comment: 新论文发布，先别急着引用，等社区复现和讨论再说。

items.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
items.title_cn: 通过选择性上下文偏好优化学习何时信任
items.summary: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. items.summary_cn: 语言模型越来越多地以外部信号作为其答案的条件，一个单一的误导性答案可能会使正确答案出错。明显的补救措施，即训练模型以抵抗此类信号，隐藏了一种失败模式：一个忽略所有上下文的模型看起来很健壮，但当上下文不...
items.comment: 新模型来了，是骡子是马拉出来遛遛，别光看宣传看实测。

items.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering
items.title_cn: 追踪心脏：心力衰竭特征工程的证据链接管道
items.summary: Electronic health record (EHR) feature engineering is a major bottleneck in clinical research and AI, accounting for 39-45% of data scientists' workload. This is especially pronounced in heart failure, which affects an estimated 6.7 million U.S. adults and requires integrating fragmented EHR data wi...
items.summary_cn: 电子健康记录（ EHR ）特征工程是临床研究和人工智能的主要瓶颈，占数据科学家工作量的39-45 ％。这在心力衰竭中尤为明显，估计有670万美国成年人受到影响，需要整合碎片化的EHR数据...
items.comment: 学术研究值不值，看实验设计和数据集，光看摘要都是纸上谈兵。

items.title: Investigating Artificial Intelligence Digital Sovereignty in Mobile Shopping Apps: A Case Study of Nigeria
items.title_cn: 调查移动购物应用程序中的人工智能数字主权：尼日利亚案例研究
items.summary: The use of e-commerce mobile applications is expanding in Nigeria, creating both opportunities and risks, including fraud and reduced user control over digital technologies, raising concerns about digital sovereignty. This research examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Nigerian mobile applica...
items.summary_cn: 电子商务移动应用程序的使用在尼日利亚不断扩大，创造了机会和风险，包括欺诈和减少用户对数字技术的控制，引发了对数字主权的担忧。这项研究探讨了尼日利亚移动应用程序中的人工智能（ AI ）如何...

items.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
items.title_cn: OpenAI表示，由于安全问题，它放慢了Astra模型的开发速度
items.summary: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.
items.summary_cn: OpenAI表示，该模型仍在开发中，已达到“关键网络安全阈值” ，这意味着它可以独立识别并针对传统上受到良好保护的现实世界系统进行网络攻击。
items.comment: 模型发布热闹非凡，能不能用、好不好用，用户说了算。

items.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
items.title_cn: Rippling在几个月内在人工智能上投入了数百万美元后，它构建了一个员工ROI工具
items.summary: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.
items.summary_cn: 在自己的AI使用唤醒电话之后， Rippling本周推出了AI Spend Console ，这是一款跟踪个人和团队员工AI支出的产品。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。

items.title: Security researchers scanned the Polish web and found courts, hospitals, and airports at risk of hacks
items.title_cn: 安全研究人员扫描了波兰的网站，发现法院、医院和机场面临黑客攻击的风险
items.summary: Researchers found common points of failure, like software used to organize and display web content, could have allowed hackers to run riot through government websites.
items.summary_cn: 研究人员发现，常见的故障点，如用于组织和显示网页内容的软件，可能允许黑客在政府网站上进行骚乱。
items.comment: 监管落地对行业是双刃剑，合规成本飙升，小玩家可能被挤出市场。
